notes.title: Panelak - Patch 1.8
notes.notes:
🆕 New Features

 Added full support for Steam Input controller functions
 Added full compatibility with Steam Deck
 Added Polish localization
 Added option to adjust camera sensitivity
 Added option for widescreen resolution


🔧 Changes

 Reduced amount of available painkillers
 Adjusted throwing strength of all dynamic objects
 After completing the game, credits will play automatically
 Slightly reduced dying time
 More visible cursor on light backgrounds
 Added the ability to climb the climbing frame


⚠️ Warning: The description below contains spoilers!

✨ Improvements

 The unattached ladder now resets to its original position after loading the game — no more ladders stuck in inaccessible places
 Fixed ladder climbing — players can now continue climbing even after jumping near the ladder without having to re-approach it
 Improved dark man navigation — he can no longer kill through walls/ceilings
 Radio now turns off automatically if not turned off manually
 Simplified interaction with dynamic objects
 Reworked audio-visual effects during the monster attack behind the painting
 The "eject" button on the VHS player now allows cassette removal (previously only with right-click)
 The basement monster now always faces the player
 During the woman’s jump from the balcony, the camera is forced to focus on her
 Highlighted the center position of the dial in the electrical cabinet
 Improved lighting in the electrical cabinet for easier navigation
 The electrical cabinet is now marked with a warning sticker
 More personalized assets


🐞 Bug Fixes

 Fixed interaction with doormats — reduced the chance of falling through floor
 Fixed issue where, if the front door wasn’t opened during the buzzer, the code couldn’t be re-entered immediately
 Fixed bug where the message "I really need to focus" could still appear on the wall in later stages of the game
 Fixed bug where the train could be visible from the roof
 Fixed issue where a player already in the elevator, standing close to the doors, could be killed by the incoming train
 Fixed lava damage — players could previously escape the damage area and survive temporarily
 Fixed bug where a padlock on the rooftop door appeared already unlocked after loading the game
 Fixed rare bug where the bedroom door in apartment 21 could be unlocked earlier than intended
 Fixed issue where the dark man could kill through the peephole even if he wasn’t visible
 Fixed bug where the journal could, in some cases, appear empty after loading the game
 Fixed a rare bug where the player could get stuck in a locked bedroom.
 Fixed flickering icons when scrolling through the inventory.

notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.notes:
Update Log – Contains Spoilers
Note: Some changes may only take effect after starting a new game.

Major Changes:

 Added Czech voice acting
 Now possible to "play" the piano



Important:

 All settings now persist after restarting the game
 Fixed map boundaries to ensure proper functionality—no matter which direction the player walks, they will always return to the apartment building
 Fixed a bug where repeated crouch-jumping could "glitch" through slanted walls and stairs in the basement
 Resolved an issue where the "Load Game" option was available in the menu even when no saved game existed


Improvements:

 Lowered default volume level
 Adjusted volume of certain sounds
 Added missing Czech translations
 Fixed text errors
 Larger interactive cursor
 Shortened the required time for staring at paintings
 Improved responsiveness for focusing on the "wall that shouldn't be there"
 Made handling the final painting more intuitive (it can now be hung in more places), and added missing collision to nearby objects
 Phone booth now recognizes 158 as a valid number
 Improved events in the room with falling tiles (screams now occur only after falling, and it's no longer possible to stay by the door)
 Changed the confusing "000" label on the elevator repair tape to "XXX"
 Easier key collection with larger interactive areas
 Fixed czech text overflow issues in the inventory screen

notes.title: Patch 1.6.1
notes.notes:
Important:

 Fixed a bug where, if the player picked up the "medicals" in the basement before falling there via the elevator and then died or loaded the game, it was no longer possible to give the medicine to the man.


Improvements:

 Added missing Czech translations.

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.notes:
Important:

 Fixed an issue where notes in the journal would disappear after loading the game in apartment 18.
 Fixed a bug where the player could bypass the backrooms without unlocking the exit.
 Prevented the ability to pick up key 21 from a long distance without activating the portal to the backrooms.


Improvements:

 Added the ability to navigate the inventory using the Q and E keys.
 Added an option to invert the mouse controls in settings.
 Added an option to disable motion blur in settings.
 Improved lighting quality in apartment 18 (fixed light leak).
 Reduced flashlight brightness.
 Simplified some controls.
 Fixed text errors.

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.notes:
SPOILER ALERT

Important:

 Fixed a logical error where the player could enter the apartment with the paintings without obtaining the key to the electrical cabinet, leading to multiple issues in the subsequent progression.
 Fixed a bug where the doors in apartment 21 would not lock.
 Fixed an issue where the player could bypass the "backrooms" section without entering it. This part now works as originally intended.
 Fixed a bug where returning from the rooftop room allowed the player to re-enter the apartment with the paintings, triggering an autosave again.


Improvements:

 Diary entries have been adjusted to better reflect the current situation during non-linear gameplay.
 Fixed an issue where the player could stop the elevator during its fall and reach the upper floor.
 Added more prominent hints in problematic areas of the game.
 Implemented volume control.
 Fixed text errors.
 Added a tutorial level for better understanding of the controls.
 Fixed a collision issue with the cabinet blocking the stairs.
 Removed unnecessary physics interactions for the chair near the dumpsters.
 Improved object collisions during the train sequence.
